1. Premises, verified in code:
- Every engine poll of a pending transform round re-enters the stage executor as a NEW round. ProgramStageExecutor.java:71 calls rounds.openRound(request) per request; MidRoundPushRounds.java:92 and SandboxRoundEnvironmentSource.java:111 mint a new token (RoundTokenMint.java:47, RoundToken.of(tip)) without looking at request.pending(). The entry carries T0 (TransformRound.java:59), the open round/next snapshot carries T1 (the pending commit's tip).
- Every poll that answers pending closes the round again: box ProgramStageExecutor.java:93 via ProgramResultMapping.closeOf (decides by role only), host SnapshottingStageExecutor.java:62-72. Each registers a fresh pending-snapshot above the pending commit, so a kill after ANY poll is window K1 (re-driven start, against NFR-R3 and the K2/K3 rows of D11), plus one commit per poll.

- Host terminal-poll snapshot judges the gnome range from the open token (WorktreeSnapshot.judge), which then includes the factory's S and P commits.

Affected: MidRoundPushRounds.openRound, SandboxRoundEnvironmentSource.openRound, ProgramStageExecutor (close per request, no adoption), SnapshottingStageExecutor, ProgramResultMapping.closeOf, WorktreeSnapshot.judge. Safe: CheckRound (box per request by design, adoption passed), GitAttemptPersistence.persist, EnvironmentAttemptPersistence.persist/persistPending (take the registered commit from the cell), RoundTokenTake.
